findings.title: Witness tenure passes to the watcher

findings.mechanism: The duration form meets the first witness predicate, the departure form marks the end of that tenure, and the emphatic watcher clause takes over the same people before the final witness expands through every thing. The supplied 5:109 connection adds God's exclusive knowledge of the unseen to that contrast.
findings.reader_payoff: Witness is newly visible as a time-bounded human office within the scene, followed by an oversight that remains and reaches beyond the community to the full field of knowable things.
findings.containment: The focus preserves both direct human witnessing and divine comprehensive witnessing. The departure branch is used for the supplied completion-of-life-span image, without deciding every metaphysical implication of the departure.

epistemic.reason: The channel record and its focus carriers are trusted and exact, while the assembled tenure-and-transfer statement is an interpretive synthesis bounded to the supplied focus and 5:109 connection.
